data.body: Anti-pattern scan complete: 3 confirmed same-class candidates (gov-copy-writer.md, doc-writer.md, ui-designer.md) — all write harvestable artifacts under sprint Phase E worktree isolation and lacked the retention staging instruction. All 3 fixed in this session (added ## Worktree Retention section, RED->GREEN 1->4 PASS). Structural test tests/agents/test-file-writing-agents-have-retention.sh now guards all 4 file-writing isolation agents; added to .test-index for each. Read-only agents (investigators, *-evaluator/classifier/decomposer, completion-verifier, planner, bot-psychologist) and non-isolated code-reviewers correctly excluded. OBSERVATION: the same 3 siblings also lack the '## Startup: Session HEAD Sync' section (separate a951-class gap — they may start from origin/main rather than session HEAD when dispatched under isolation); noted for a follow-up, out of scope for this retention bug. Defense-in-depth 907d recover-path (make per-worktree-review-commit.md Step 1a recover rather than HALT-only) also deferred to follow-up.
